templates.source: Arecont Vision API and Camera Web Page Manual (2017-06-30), Chapter IV - Alternative Access Protocols, 'RTSP Request Format for Continuous H.264 Video Streaming' (sales.arecontvision.com/marketing/contents/Arecont%20Vision%20API%20and%20Camera%20Web%20Page%20Manual_2017-06-30_1.pdf); minimal form rtsp://camera_ip/h264.sdp?res=full&doublescan=0&fps=fps&ssn=[1..65535], res=full = full resolution (main)
Arecont Vision API and Camera Web Page Manual (2017-06-30), same RTSP section; res=half reduces resolution by a factor of 2 in each direction (sub/second stream)

Arecont Vision API and Camera Web Page Manual (2017-06-30): multi-sensor form rtsp://camera_ip/h264.sdp<channel>?res=(half|full)... for Omni, SurroundVideo and other multi-sensor MegaVideo models; <N> = sensor/channel index (1-based, seen as sdp1/sdp3 in leads)

Arecont Vision Support KB, 'How to connect to RTSP streams on Contera cameras' (support.arecontvision.com/hc/en-us/articles/360026045753); e.g. rtsp://<ip>:554/stream1_1 main stream, append _X for channel X on multi-channel Contera (MicroDome Duo, Omni LX/RS)

Arecont Vision Support KB, 'How to connect to RTSP streams on Contera cameras' (support.arecontvision.com/hc/en-us/articles/360026045753); e.g. rtsp://<ip>:554/stream2_1 sub stream (stream3_<N> = MJPEG)

notes: Two documented generations. (1) Legacy MegaVideo/MegaDome/SurroundVideo (H.264 models): base RTSP path /h264.sdp with query params; res=full = main (full res), res=half = sub (half res in each dimension); ssn is a required unique stream identifier (1-65535, up to 8 non-identical streams per camera); doublescan=0 = wait for fresh frame. Multi-sensor cameras (Omni, SurroundVideo) use /h264.sdp<N> where N is the sensor/channel index (leads show sdp1/sdp3). Optional params: x0/y0/x1/y1 (crop), qp, ratelimit, bitrate, fps, sei. (2) Contera (ConteraIP, newer H.264/H.265 platform): /stream1_<N> = main, /stream2_<N> = sub, /stream3_<N> = MJPEG; append _X for the channel on multi-channel/multi-sensor models (MicroDome Duo, Omni LX/RS 1-4). Default RTSP unicast port 554 (configurable 1-65535) confirmed in the API manual. Arecont was acquired by Costar Technologies; the HTTP/RTSP API also lives at http-api.arecontvision.com. Leads contained Hikvision PSIA and Axis media.amp cross-brand contamination — excluded.
